SUMMARY SHEET ON THE 1941 SEP 21 EARTHQUAKE (SHEET 3 OF 4)

Shanghang ~20 sec - Felt nearly by all people
- A few people frightened
- Hanging objects swung
- Vibrations felt like passing of trucks
- Noise heard

Jiaoling - Felt outdoors
- Nobody frightened
- No falling of plaster dust
- Noise sounds like overturning of heavy
trucks

Dingnan - Felt indoors
- Hanging objects swung
- Falling of plaster dust
- Noise sounds like passing of heavy
trucks

Wuping ~30 sec - Felt by all
- Many frightened
- Hanging objects swung heavily
- Falling of plaster
- Windows, doors, etc. rattled
- No houses collapsed
- Noise sounds like passing of trains

Ruijin - Felt indoors
- Strong vibrations
- Windows, doors and tiles rattled
- Falling of unstable tiles
- Noise sounds like explosion
- One house collapsed

Huichang - Felt by all people
- Some frightened
- Hanging objects swung
- Falling of plaster dust
- Vibrations from south-east
- No damage to houses
- Noise sounds like passing of trucks

Xunwu ~2 min - Felt by all
- Many frightened
- Hanging objects swung
- Hanging bells rang
